purpose: Factual combat fields, package inheritance and numeric subentity transforms for the analysed mission profiles.
limitations: Engine defaults and external base templates are not filled with invented values.
Role weights are raw relative weights, not independently verified spawn frequencies.
Raw equipment/weapon fields require the chosen Oolite engine.
Models are identified but no third-party model/texture/script assets are bundled.
String subentity definitions retain factual resource ID and transform; each engine must parse its supported format.

core_resolution_source.limitations: Pinned core plus own package fields only. No other installed replacement OXP; engine defaults, equipment and runtime overrides remain separate.

inheritance_semantics: O08 OOShipRegistry.mergeShip removes like_ship and non-inherited display_name/is_template, and selects child aliases for scan class, escort role/ship, carrier and shipyard. Own dictionaries remain original source fields; runtime defaults/equipment remain separate.
